subject: osprey
title: This Bird Eats Almost Only Fish and Misses 3 Dives in 4

scenes.text: This bird eats fish almost all the time, and misses three dives out of four.
An osprey spots a fish from nearly 100 feet up, then plunges feet first.
It is the only bird of prey that plunge-dives for live fish, 99 percent of the time.
Its outer toe swings backward, and barbed pads grip the slippery fish.
It can lift a fish nearly as heavy as the bird itself.
Three misses, one meal, and it dives again.

description:
An osprey misses about three dives in four, yet fish make up 99 percent of its diet.
Reversible toes and barbed pads help it hold fish almost as heavy as itself.
